items.title: 10 fishermen from Rameswaram held by Sri Lankan Navy on charges of fishing beyond Katchatheevu islet
items.summary: A senior official in the TN Fisheries department said that the arrested fishermen were taken to Talaimannar Naval Port and are likely to be produced in a court during the day.

items.title: Millions crowd cities to see Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century
items.summary: As the sky darkened, gradually at first and then quickly, people broke into applause and cheered. It was the Spain's first total solar eclipse in more than a century.
